# Dinn
Multi-launchpad AI workspace. Pons on Robinhood Chain is the first integration in development. Ascend and Montra on Elysium: Coming soon.
- Agent guide: /agent-guide.md
- Manifest: /.well-known/launchflow.json
- Schema: /api/agent/schema
- Status: /api/status
Pons ETH and approved ERC-20 pair launches use explicit review, simulation and wallet approval. Trading, bridging and fee claims remain disabled.

DEX Screener profile preparation, external checkout handoff and public order/metadata checks are available. No automatic purchase or submission.

DEX profile drafting: open_dex_profile with a token address reads contract identity and available GeckoTerminal metadata, then uses inference to draft a description. Reported project claims require review; missing links stay blank. If inference fails, source-based text is returned. Only network and address are prefilled externally.
